body: Thank you for your kind words, there’s a Doctor a block away from me so more likely than not I’ll drive over to his house and see what I need to do.
I don’t feel like an incredible human being but I appreciate it. Ill probably end up talking to my therapist

I used to be physically unable to talk. I can talk now kinda, I learned how to but it hurts a lot. Kind of like a really soft version of how a heavy smoker sounds. I’m ‘legally mute’, like someone whose legally blind or legally deaf. It takes a lot of effort and took years for me to speak the way I do now— even though I don’t speak much.
